script: "That actor's stalker turned out to be his own guest—my life was destroyed.". I was the NA for a boutique hotel, just five nights left before I handed over the keys. A guy who'd done a few indie films and one TV drama was staying long‑term. He'd been a total sweetheart, waving at me every time I walked past the lobby. A couple nights ago, I am strolling past his room when he pulls back into the lobby with a face that said, "What is that woman doing here and why did you let her in?" I had no clue who he was talking about. He says, "She's trying to follow me into my room." I followed him. The woman was sitting in her room with the door open, like she'd been waiting for him. He walked toward his room, she followed, and I stepped in. "Please go back to your room," I said. She didn't even look at me. I had to pull her back—no force, just a firm tug of the big bow on her outfit—and shove her toward her room. He got into his room. Later she turned to me and asked if he'd complained. "I did. You were trying to follow him into his room," I replied. I told the FOM and GM in the morning. They said, "If she does it again, just trespass her." Fast forward to today. She's walking toward her room again, and she says, "You shouldn't have told him to leave. I would've left if you'd asked me." I am like, "I have no idea what you're talking about. I can't discuss other guests." I know for a fact he didn't leave. He came back an hour later, and we finally talked. Turns out she's not just a random fan; she's his stalker. She once found his house, sat outside his front door for four hours, ring‑ring‑ring, and he told the GM about it. She's more of a lovesick puppy than a menace, but that's not an excuse. They didn't trespass her yet because she hasn't tried again. What's wild is she booked a second room for her last night through an OTA, so now she has two rooms for the final night. I am stuck waiting to see if she'll finally get kicked out. The only thing I know is that this is a game, and I am the player who's got to keep the peace.
